from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP

# ==========================================
# CONSTANTS SECTION (Income-tax Act, 1961)
# ==========================================

# Sec 16(ia) - Standard deduction amounts
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = Decimal("50000")  # Sec 16(ia)
STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = Decimal("75000")  # Sec 16(ia) proviso (Sec 115BAC)

# Sec 10(13A) - HRA metro percentage
HRA_METRO_RATE = Decimal("0.50")  # Sec 10(13A)(c) - Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai
HRA_NON_METRO_RATE = Decimal("0.40")  # Sec 10(13A)(c) - Elsewhere
HRA_RENT_EXCESS_RATE = Decimal("0.10")  # Sec 10(13A)(b) - Rent paid in excess of 10% of salary

# Sec 24(b) & Sec 71(3A) - Self-occupied house property loss limit
SOP_INTEREST_LIMIT = Decimal("200000")  # Sec 24(b)

# Chapter VI-A limits (Old Regime)
SEC_80C_LIMIT = Decimal("150000")  # Sec 80C / 80CCE
SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT = Decimal("50000")  # Sec 80CCD(1B)
SEC_80D_SELF_LIMIT = Decimal("25000")  # Sec 80D(i)
SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR_LIMIT = Decimal("50000")  # Sec 80D(i) - senior citizen
SEC_80D_PARENT_LIMIT = Decimal("25000")  # Sec 80D(ii)
SEC_80D_PARENT_SENIOR_LIMIT = Decimal("50000")  # Sec 80D(ii) - senior parent

# First Schedule, Part III, Para A - Old regime tax slabs (lower, upper, rate)
SLABS_OLD_BELOW_60 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("250000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("250000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]
SLABS_OLD_60_TO_79 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("300000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("300000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]
SLABS_OLD_80_PLUS = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

# Sec 115BAC(1A)(iii) - New regime tax slabs (same for all ages)
SLABS_NEW = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("400000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("400000"), Decimal("800000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("800000"), Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("1600000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("1600000"), Decimal("2000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("2000000"), Decimal("2400000"), Decimal("0.25")),
    (Decimal("2400000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

# Sec 87A - Rebate thresholds and limits
REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_OLD = Decimal("500000")  # Sec 87A (old)
REBATE_MAX_OLD = Decimal("12500")  # Sec 87A (old)
REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_NEW = Decimal("1200000")  # Sec 87A (new)
REBATE_MAX_NEW = Decimal("60000")  # Sec 87A (new)

# First Schedule - Surcharge tiers (threshold, rate)
SURCHARGE_TIERS_OLD = [
    (Decimal("5000000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("10000000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("20000000"), Decimal("0.25")),
    (Decimal("50000000"), Decimal("0.37")),
]
SURCHARGE_TIERS_NEW = [
    (Decimal("5000000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("10000000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("20000000"), Decimal("0.25")),  # Capped at 25% under new regime
]

# Health and Education Cess rate
CESS_RATE = Decimal("0.04")  # Health and Education Cess


def round_nearest_ten(amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """Sec 288A / Sec 288B rounding: floor paise, then nearest ten."""
    floored = amount.quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)
    return floored.quantize(Decimal("10"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)


def compute_regime_result(
    gross_salary: Decimal,
    age: int,
    hra_received: Decimal,
    basic_plus_da: Decimal,
    rent_paid: Decimal,
    rent_city_is_metro: bool,
    home_loan_interest: Decimal,
    sec_80c: Decimal,
    sec_80ccd_1b: Decimal,
    health_ins_self: Decimal,
    health_ins_parents: Decimal,
    parents_senior: bool,
    is_new_regime: bool,
) -> dict:
    trace = []
    income_sum_running = Decimal("0")
    tax_sum_running = Decimal("0")

    # --- 1. Salary Income & Deductions ---
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Gross salary",
        "amount": str(gross_salary),
        "clause": "Sec 17(1)",
    })
    income_sum_running += gross_salary

    # Standard deduction
    std_ded = STD_DEDUCTION_NEW if is_new_regime else STD_DEDUCTION_OLD
    actual_std_ded = min(std_ded, gross_salary)
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Standard deduction",
        "amount": str(-actual_std_ded),
        "clause": "Sec 16(ia)" if not is_new_regime else "Sec 16(ia) proviso (Sec 115BAC)",
    })
    income_sum_running -= actual_std_ded
    net_salary = gross_salary - actual_std_ded

    # HRA exemption (old regime only)
    hra_exempt = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new_regime and hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
        cond_a = hra_received
        excess_rent = rent_paid - (basic_plus_da * HRA_RENT_EXCESS_RATE)
        cond_b = max(Decimal("0"), excess_rent)
        city_rate = HRA_METRO_RATE if rent_city_is_metro else HRA_NON_METRO_RATE
        cond_c = basic_plus_da * city_rate
        hra_exempt = min(cond_a, cond_b, cond_c)
        if hra_exempt > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "House rent allowance exemption",
                "amount": str(-hra_exempt),
                "clause": "Sec 10(13A)",
            })
            income_sum_running -= hra_exempt

    salary_after_hra = net_salary - hra_exempt

    # House property loss (old regime only)
    hp_loss = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new_regime and home_loan_interest > 0:
        hp_loss = min(home_loan_interest, SOP_INTEREST_LIMIT)
        if hp_loss > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Loss from self-occupied house property set off",
                "amount": str(-hp_loss),
                "clause": "Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A)",
            })
            income_sum_running -= hp_loss

    gross_total_income = max(Decimal("0"), salary_after_hra - hp_loss)

    # --- 2. Chapter VI-A Deductions (Old Regime only) ---
    chapter_vi_a_total = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new_regime:
        # 80C
        d_80c = min(sec_80c, SEC_80C_LIMIT)
        if d_80c > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80C",
                "amount": str(-d_80c),
                "clause": "Sec 80C",
            })
            income_sum_running -= d_80c
            chapter_vi_a_total += d_80c

        # 80CCD(1B)
        d_80ccd_1b = min(sec_80ccd_1b, SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT)
        if d_80ccd_1b > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80CCD(1B)",
                "amount": str(-d_80ccd_1b),
                "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)",
            })
            income_sum_running -= d_80ccd_1b
            chapter_vi_a_total += d_80ccd_1b

        # 80D
        is_self_senior = age >= 60
        self_limit = SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR_LIMIT if is_self_senior else SEC_80D_SELF_LIMIT
        d_80d_self = min(health_ins_self, self_limit)

        parent_limit = SEC_80D_PARENT_SENIOR_LIMIT if parents_senior else SEC_80D_PARENT_LIMIT
        d_80d_parent = min(health_ins_parents, parent_limit)

        d_80d_total = d_80d_self + d_80d_parent
        if d_80d_total > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80D for health insurance",
                "amount": str(-d_80d_total),
                "clause": "Sec 80D",
            })
            income_sum_running -= d_80d_total
            chapter_vi_a_total += d_80d_total

        # Sec 80A(2) Overall cap: total deductions cannot exceed gross total income
        if chapter_vi_a_total > gross_total_income:
            excess = chapter_vi_a_total - gross_total_income
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Chapter VI-A cap restriction (Sec 80A(2))",
                "amount": str(excess),
                "clause": "Sec 80A(2)",
            })
            income_sum_running += excess
            chapter_vi_a_total = gross_total_income

    total_income_unrounded = max(Decimal("0"), gross_total_income - chapter_vi_a_total)

    # Sec 288A Rounding of total income
    total_income_rounded = round_nearest_ten(total_income_unrounded)
    income_adjustment = total_income_rounded - total_income_unrounded
    if income_adjustment != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Rounding of total income",
            "amount": str(income_adjustment),
            "clause": "Sec 288A",
        })
        income_sum_running += income_adjustment

    total_income = total_income_rounded

    # --- 3. Tax Computation ---
    # Select slabs
    if is_new_regime:
        slabs = SLABS_NEW
    else:
        if age >= 80:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_80_PLUS
        elif age >= 60:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_60_TO_79
        else:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_BELOW_60

    # Compute slab tax band by band
    tax_unrounded = Decimal("0")
    for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
        if total_income <= lower:
            continue
        taxable_in_band = (
            (min(total_income, upper) - lower)
            if upper is not None
            else (total_income - lower)
        )
        band_tax = taxable_in_band * rate
        if band_tax > 0:
            upper_str = str(upper) if upper is not None else "above"
            trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": f"Tax on slab {lower} to {upper_str} at {rate * 100}%",
                "amount": str(band_tax),
                "clause": "First Schedule, Part III, Para A"
                if not is_new_regime
                else "Sec 115BAC(1A)(iii)",
            })
            tax_sum_running += band_tax
            tax_unrounded += band_tax

    # --- 4. Sec 87A Rebate & Marginal Relief ---
    rebate = Decimal("0")
    if is_new_regime:
        if total_income <= REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_NEW:
            rebate = min(tax_unrounded, REBATE_MAX_NEW)
        elif total_income > REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_NEW:
            # Marginal relief for new regime rebate
            tax_after_normal_rebate = tax_unrounded
            excess_income = total_income - REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_NEW
            if tax_after_normal_rebate > excess_income:
                rebate = tax_after_normal_rebate - excess_income
    else:
        if total_income <= REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_OLD:
            rebate = min(tax_unrounded, REBATE_MAX_OLD)

    if rebate > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rebate under Section 87A",
            "amount": str(-rebate),
            "clause": "Sec 87A",
        })
        tax_sum_running -= rebate

    tax_after_rebate = max(Decimal("0"), tax_unrounded - rebate)

    # --- 5. Surcharge & Marginal Relief ---
    surcharge_tiers = SURCHARGE_TIERS_NEW if is_new_regime else SURCHARGE_TIERS_OLD
    surcharge_rate = Decimal("0")
    applicable_tier_threshold = Decimal("0")
    for threshold, rate in surcharge_tiers:
        if total_income > threshold:
            surcharge_rate = rate
            applicable_tier_threshold = threshold

    raw_surcharge = tax_after_rebate * surcharge_rate

    if raw_surcharge > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": f"Surcharge at {surcharge_rate * 100}%",
            "amount": str(raw_surcharge),
            "clause": "First Schedule",
        })
        tax_sum_running += raw_surcharge

        # Surcharge Marginal Relief check
        # Tax + Surcharge at actual total income
        tax_plus_surcharge_actual = tax_after_rebate + raw_surcharge

        # Tax + Surcharge at threshold limit
        # Compute tax at threshold
        thresh_tax_unrounded = Decimal("0")
        for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
            if applicable_tier_threshold <= lower:
                continue
            taxable_in_band = (
                (min(applicable_tier_threshold, upper) - lower)
                if upper is not None
                else (applicable_tier_threshold - lower)
            )
            thresh_tax_unrounded += taxable_in_band * rate

        # Rebate at threshold (if any)
        thresh_rebate = Decimal("0")
        if is_new_regime and applicable_tier_threshold <= REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_NEW:
            thresh_rebate = min(thresh_tax_unrounded, REBATE_MAX_NEW)
        elif not is_new_regime and applicable_tier_threshold <= REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_OLD:
            thresh_rebate = min(thresh_tax_unrounded, REBATE_MAX_OLD)
        thresh_tax_after_rebate = max(Decimal("0"), thresh_tax_unrounded - thresh_rebate)
        thresh_surcharge = thresh_tax_after_rebate * surcharge_rate
        tax_plus_surcharge_thresh = thresh_tax_after_rebate + thresh_surcharge

        max_allowed = tax_plus_surcharge_thresh + (
            total_income - applicable_tier_threshold
        )
        if tax_plus_surcharge_actual > max_allowed:
            surcharge_relief = tax_plus_surcharge_actual - max_allowed
            trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": "Surcharge marginal relief",
                "amount": str(-surcharge_relief),
                "clause": "First Schedule",
            })
            tax_sum_running -= surcharge_relief
            raw_surcharge -= surcharge_relief

    tax_plus_surcharge = tax_after_rebate + raw_surcharge

    # --- 6. Health and Education Cess ---
    cess = tax_plus_surcharge * CESS_RATE
    if cess > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Health and Education Cess at 4%",
            "amount": str(cess),
            "clause": "Finance Act / Income-tax Act",
        })
        tax_sum_running += cess

    tax_total_unrounded = tax_plus_surcharge + cess

    # Sec 288B Rounding of tax payable
    tax_total_rounded = round_nearest_ten(tax_total_unrounded)
    tax_adjustment = tax_total_rounded - tax_total_unrounded
    if tax_adjustment != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rounding of tax payable",
            "amount": str(tax_adjustment),
            "clause": "Sec 288B",
        })
        tax_sum_running += tax_adjustment

    tax_payable = max(Decimal("0"), tax_total_rounded)

    return {
        "total_income": int(total_income),
        "tax_payable": int(tax_payable),
        "trace": trace,
    }


def compute(inp: dict) -> dict:
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp.get("gross_salary", 0)))
    age = int(inp.get("age", 0))
    hra_received = Decimal(str(inp.get("hra_received", 0)))
    basic_plus_da = Decimal(str(inp.get("basic_plus_da", 0)))
    rent_paid = Decimal(str(inp.get("rent_paid", 0)))
    rent_city_is_metro = bool(inp.get("rent_city_is_metro", False))
    home_loan_interest = Decimal(str(inp.get("home_loan_interest", 0)))
    sec_80c = Decimal(str(inp.get("sec_80c", 0)))
    sec_80ccd_1b = Decimal(str(inp.get("sec_80ccd_1b", 0)))
    health_ins_self = Decimal(str(inp.get("health_ins_self", 0)))
    health_ins_parents = Decimal(str(inp.get("health_ins_parents", 0)))
    parents_senior = bool(inp.get("parents_senior", False))

    old_result = compute_regime_result(
        gross_salary=gross_salary,
        age=age,
        hra_received=hra_received,
        basic_plus_da=basic_plus_da,
        rent_paid=rent_paid,
        rent_city_is_metro=rent_city_is_metro,
        home_loan_interest=home_loan_interest,
        sec_80c=sec_80c,
        sec_80ccd_1b=sec_80ccd_1b,
        health_ins_self=health_ins_self,
        health_ins_parents=health_ins_parents,
        parents_senior=parents_senior,
        is_new_regime=False,
    )

    new_result = compute_regime_result(
        gross_salary=gross_salary,
        age=age,
        hra_received=hra_received,
        basic_plus_da=basic_plus_da,
        rent_paid=rent_paid,
        rent_city_is_metro=rent_city_is_metro,
        home_loan_interest=home_loan_interest,
        sec_80c=sec_80c,
        sec_80ccd_1b=sec_80ccd_1b,
        health_ins_self=health_ins_self,
        health_ins_parents=health_ins_parents,
        parents_senior=parents_senior,
        is_new_regime=True,
    )

    return {"old": old_result, "new": new_result}
